speedup.title: Used a speedup
speedup.hint: Speedups of any kind subtract their minutes from the time left.

setTime.title: Set the time left
setTime.hint: Use this when the game shows a different time.

planStock.title: Do you have enough?
planStock.description: What the plan takes from your stock, checked against what you hold. The full plan is in the result below.
planStock.stillNeeded: Still needed for the full plan: {list}.

start.title: Start upgrade
start.nothingToStart: Nothing can be started right now. Every item is at its top level, locked, or already upgrading.
start.timeHint: Only the speed from your Bonuses page is counted. If the game shows another time, change it under When it started.
start.allBusy: Everything here is busy. Start upgrade is off until one frees.
start.startedHint: Pick Already started to enter the time the game shows. The end time is worked out from it.

takeCost.title: Take the cost from Resources
takeCost.hint: Subtracts the cost above from your stock.
takeCost.enough: You have enough of every resource.
takeCost.short: You are short on {names}. You can still start, and the stock stops at 0.
